Evidence/CLM-019
Evidence record

Enforcement decisions are events, not a market census

What does this evidence establish?

Governor's decisions of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) dated January to September 2026 record licence withdrawals, suspensions and closures for specific exchange and remittance providers. This record covers selected CBY-Aden Governor's decisions of 2026 concerning exchange and remittance providers (Nos. 1–6, 9–11, 13–15, 17 and 18); other decision numbers are not included and their subjects are not assessed. The official 2026 roster can be counted by class, but these decisions are matched with it entity by entity and are not subtracted from it to produce a count of providers operating now.

What does it measure?

Licence withdrawals, suspensions and closures of named exchange and remittance providers ordered in selected Governor's decisions of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) dated January to September 2026.

Who or what does it apply to?

Only the providers named in the decisions covered here (for Decision No. 18, the named entities have not yet been transcribed); not the full set of exchange and remittance providers

When was it measured or observed?

Decisions dated 1 January to 24 September 2026

How current is it?

The latest decision in this record is Governor's Decision No. 18 of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), dated 24 September 2026. It should not be read as describing any provider's status after that date unless a newer decision is added.

What this evidence does not establish

The 2026 annual roster can be counted by class, but it is not a census of operating providers. Subtracting suspension, withdrawal and closure decisions from the roster does not give a current count of operating providers: the roster does not state its issue date, so each decision is matched to named entities one by one, without assuming whether the roster already reflects it. A provider not named in these decisions is not thereby shown to be active or compliant. The record does not cover 2026 decision numbers other than those listed, and it does not assess their subjects.

Method and verification detailDetail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Each decision is taken from its official publication by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) and recorded by date, action and the entity or class of entity it names. The entities named in Decision No. 18 of 24 September 2026 have not yet been transcribed. The decisions are not treated as a census of all providers or as proof that a listed provider is currently operating.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

Verify the annual roster category counts, then reconcile later dated status events entity by entity while keeping the event date and the distinction between formal status and verified operation visible.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
